name.description: Display name, e.g. Notify Slack on sold lead

enabled.description: Whether this webhook fires. Created disabled so a payload can be tested before anything leaves the system.

trigger.description: What causes this webhook to fire. manual means it only ever runs from the Test button, which is the safe default.

url.description: Absolute https endpoint the payload is posted to

api_key.description: The API key or token this connection authenticates with, stored on the record. Admin-only by RLS. Never rendered in a list view; the UI shows a masked hint and reveals the value only on an explicit action.

credential_env.description: NAME of the environment secret holding the token, never the token itself. Resolved server side at send time and never returned to the browser.

auth_header.description: Authorization header template, e.g. 'Bearer {{secret}}'. {{secret}} is replaced server side with the value of credential_env. Blank sends no Authorization header.

headers.description: JSON object of additional static headers. Never put a credential here; use credential_env and auth_header.

filters.description: JSON array of {field, operator, value} conditions, using the same operator set as the rest of the app. All must pass for the webhook to fire. An empty array fires on every matching trigger.

payload_fields.description: JSON array of {key, source, value} describing the body. source 'field' takes the record's value for `value`; source 'static' sends `value` verbatim; source 'custom_field' takes the named CustomField. Order is preserved so the body reads the way the receiver expects.

payload_mode.description: builder composes the body from payload_fields. template sends payload_template verbatim with {{field}} placeholders substituted.

payload_template.description: Raw JSON body used when payload_mode is template. Supports {{field}} placeholders resolved against the record.

last_status.description: Outcome of the most recent send, e.g. 'HTTP 200' or 'Filtered out'

last_error.description: Most recent failure summary. Never contains the credential.
